structureAdjudications.reason: TR1894 is authoritative. The two genitive tokens form the name/title phrase modifying δοῦλοι and remain in TR order; the reversed MACULA terminals are not reused as token identities.

John Wry confirmed the TR1894-native structure. TR1894 reads ἀπὸ πρώτης ἡμέρας and contains no article before πρώτης. The unmatched MACULA terminal τῆς is removed, while the exact AdjpNp child πρώτης ἡμέρας is promoted unchanged as the complement of ἀπό.
TR1894 is authoritative. Its terminal is ἄχρις, not MACULA's ἄχρι; the surrounding PrepNp attachment remains applicable, but the MACULA terminal is not reused as the TR token identity.
TR1894 is authoritative. The genitive name/title phrase modifying ἡμέρας remains in TR order; the reversed MACULA terminals are not reused as token identities.

TR1894 order is ἐν τε τοῖς δεσμοῖς μου. The existing exact anchors and the noun-phrase subtree are retained, but the group is rebuilt in authoritative TR order instead of MACULA's nested τε + ἐν phrase order.

TR1894 is authoritative and has no second ἐν before τῇ ἀπολογίᾳ. The dative noun phrase is the coordinated second member and inherits the prepositional relation from ἐν τε τοῖς δεσμοῖς μου; the absent MACULA terminal is removed rather than linked to a TR token.
TR1894 is authoritative. συγκοινωνούς remains the accusative plural predicate with μου τῆς χάριτος; the different MACULA terminal spelling is not reused as the TR token identity.
TR1894 is authoritative and explicitly contains ἐστίν between the predicate phrase and ὁ θεός. The native TR verb is inserted without assigning it a nonexistent MACULA terminal identity.
TR1894 is authoritative. The genitive name/title phrase modifying σπλάγχνοις remains in TR order; the reversed MACULA terminals are not reused as token identities.

TR1894 is authoritative and reads the genitive plural καρπῶν, not MACULA's accusative singular καρπὸν. The native TR form remains the complement of πεπληρωμένοι without borrowing a MACULA token identity.

TR1894 is authoritative and reads the genitive plural article τῶν agreeing with καρπῶν, not MACULA's accusative singular τὸν. Its existing modifier attachment is retained without reusing the MACULA terminal identity.

John Wry confirmed the TR1894-native structure. TR1894 reads ἀφόβως τὸν λόγον λαλεῖν and contains no τοῦ Θεοῦ after λόγον. The unmatched MACULA genitive phrase is removed, while the exact TR anchors τὸν and λόγον are retained as the direct-object DetNP.

Scrivener verse limits are authoritative. MACULA places this clause in the adjacent critical-text verse; its structure is rebound to the corresponding TR1894 tokens without reusing MACULA terminal identities.

Scrivener verse limits are authoritative. MACULA places this clause in the adjacent critical-text verse; its structure is rebound to the corresponding TR1894 tokens without reusing MACULA terminal identities.
TR1894 is authoritative and reads γὰρ as the opening postpositive particle, not MACULA's δὲ.
TR1894 has no second γὰρ before μᾶλλον; the unmatched MACULA particle is removed while the exact comparative clause is retained.
TR1894 explicitly contains ἐν before the dative noun phrase. The native preposition is inserted without assigning it a nonexistent MACULA identity.
TR1894 is authoritative and contains the compound συμπαραμενῶ; the coordinated future verb retains the MACULA structural position without its terminal identity.
TR1894 is authoritative and reads the aorist subjunctive ἀκούσω in the ἵνα construction, not MACULA's indicative ἀκούω.
TR1894 is authoritative and reads αὐτοῖς μὲν ἐστίν. The clause is rebuilt in TR order while retaining the exact subject and predicate anchors.
TR1894 is authoritative and reads the dative ὑμῖν before δὲ, not MACULA's genitive ὑμῶν. The elided coordinated clause is rebuilt in TR order.

The already approved Scrivener surface εἴδετε is authoritative. Robinson supplies its morphology through the documented SCV-surface adjudication; the MACULA terminal is not reused as the TR token identity because triple surface agreement is absent upstream.
TR1894 is authoritative and has no ὅτι after πλήν. The unmatched MACULA conjunction is removed while the complete exact TR clause beneath it is retained.
